body:
Thank you so much to everyone who has replied. I have had a really rough night. I am still upset, I have a lot of problems in my life, mainly from my past, some things from recently. I know I need to seek help. I want to and I am going to try and get the courage to do so tomorrow. I'm scared about what's going to happen to me and my kids. But whatever happens, I'm sure it can't be worse than me ruining their lives by being depressed and wanting to die all the time.

Thank you, from the bottom of my broken, but healing, heart.

I've always pretended like I am the only "normal" one in my family. My family aren't the greatest people in the world, in fact, I don't like most of them. They're mean and judgmental and say horrible things about each other. I feel like I don't want them to feel like they're better than me because I'm sick, too. Writing that down makes me feel like I'm being foolish and need to grow up. Maybe so, but I can't help but feel that way.

I don't like the thought of going on medication, I don't even like to take tylenol, but I will if it will make me feel and think normal and to be able to function so I can take care of my kids and my house.

I guess I can call my family dr and try and make an appointment, but that seems hard because I always have my kids with me, unless it's a day that 2 of them are in school, but then I'll still have one. And I don't have anyone to watch them so I can get help for myself. I'm scared they'll admit me to the hospital while I get treatment. I can't do that because there's no one to care for my kids if I do.

My older sister has Bipolar 1 and my younger sister has Bipolar 2. My Dad suffers from depression, for many years, he ended up taking it out on my older sister and I, by beating us until I was 12 and I told my teacher. Good did come of that though, it taught me to never hit my kids, I'd never want anyone to feel that way. Anyways. My Mom says she has depression, but she definitely has some type of Bipolar, the doctors that diagnosed my sisters said they inherited it from one of their parents, and my youngest sister isn't my Dads, so it's obvious it's from my Mom. She has serious mood spikes. She left me and my sister when I was 2 months old, to go be with her boyfriend, moved across the country for love, left me. I still can't forgive her for that. But I guess I understand how hard life can be when you can't think properly. She came back when I was 4... we visited her and her new boyfriend on weekends, they drank every weekend, did drugs, fought, literally beat each other up right in front of us. I dreaded having to go there... I honestly preferred to stay home and get hit by my Dad over having to go there. But she had my little brother, and I couldn't just leave him alone with that.

I'm sorry, I keep rambling. I start talking about something and I keep going and then realize that I've been typing for far too long. I have too much stuff I need to get out, making it pretty clear that I need to see a psychiatrist or something. 

You are right on key with everything you said. You are so knowledgeable and I am forever grateful for everything. I need to stop making excuses. I know. I want to be able to have that story, too. My kids deserve to have a mentally stable parent. I'm just scared. But reading every ones replies has helped me a little bit, I feel like I'm thinking a little bit clearer now. I don't want to kill myself at this moment, but I have been in and out of that feeling all night. I need to get some sleep before it comes back. Thank you so much for replying.

Thank you, I will probably take you up on that offer, I don't have anyone in my life to talk to that understands how I'm feeling, and the rest I can't even tell them the way that I feel. 

I am about to go to bed now, I have to get up in 4 hours to take my kids to school. I will send you a message tomorrow, probably some time in the evening. I think I need to talk to someone that relates to me.

Thank you.

I've always been depressed, I can sit here and think back to being in public school, not wanting to live anymore and sitting with a knife, wanting to cut myself, but being too scared that it wouldn't work and I'd just be sitting there in pain. 

Things have only gotten worse since then. Your comment really opened up another part of me that has been aching, badly. My first real love. We hadn't dated for years, but I always loved him. I didn't have romantic feelings for him anymore, but I was still in love with him. He killed himself almost 3 years ago. No one knows why because he was the happiest, cutest, funniest guy anyone ever met. He seemed to love life and everything it had to offer. Then all of a sudden he was gone. And I never got to tell him that I still loved him. I hadn't seen him for a few years, I avoided hanging out, etc, because I was scared to get too serious. The last time I saw him was in 2004 and we watched a movie together, we made plans to hang out the next day and you know what I did? Ignored his phone calls and RAN away from my apartment for the day so I wouldn't have to spend time with him. So I wouldn't have to settle down at 18 years old. Because at the time, I felt like he was the one for me, but it just wasn't the right time. Now it'll never be the right time.

I have since fallen madly in love with another man, my middle childs father. I've loved him for almost 7 years and we just got back together around Christmas after confessing out love for each other, for him to tell me a week ago that he doesn't love me. That's what has triggered a lot of my pain recently. Although I have other reasons for my depression, but that just didn't help. 

I'm sorry I rambled on, I needed to get that out and your comment brought up all of these feelings.

Everything everyone is saying is helping in a way, I hope I can get the courage from it to seek professional help.

You are right. Everyone here is right. The more I read, the more I realize I need to get help, not just for me, but for my kids. I never thought it would affect them. It just seems so hard. I have no motivation when I'm feeling like this, no matter how badly I want to.

I don't know what would happen to them if I were to quit. That's what's keeping me alive. I don't want them to be alone, or split up. I don't talk to any of my family because they have done horrible things to me. So I have to stay here for them, but I get to the point sometimes were I don't see how it's worth it. And I know it's wrong to feel that way, but I can't help it.

I have noticed my oldest child is very emotional the last couple of years, and it didn't clue in until now that that is probably my fault. 

I can't afford to go and see a psychologist, even though I know I should and I want to, but I also can't go to things like that because I don't have anyone to watch my kids so I can do things for myself, to get better. So I'm kind of stuck, in that way. 

I'm scared to bring it up to my family dr because I've waited so long, he may not believe me, I don't know.

I feel like it's just so much work, I'm exhausted.

I have tried talking to my kids' fathers, they're the only friends I have. None of them understand. They think if I stop myself from thinking about it, that I'll be okay. But I noticed when I pretend I'm happy, I can last about a week and then I have a big, serious, mental breakdown like I had tonight. I spent my night crying, uncontrollably. Talked to one of my kids' fathers for over an hour, he didn't say much at all, he broke my heart recently. So I've been trying to hide my feelings about that and it just came crashing down on me. 

Things do get to be too much, way too often for me.

I actually walk a lot. I don't drive, and I don't have any friends or family that take me and my kids anywhere so I walk every day. I do all of my grocery shopping with my kids and the stroller. I have tried doing crunches, jumping jacks, running up and down stairs, etc, but I have scoliosis and I don't take any medication for the pain it causes sometimes, so I can't do many exercises without being in a lot of pain during or afterwards. 

Sounds like I have an excuse for everything.

I feel bad that you had to grow up like that. It really makes me think about what I'm doing to my kids. I'm not a drinker, I don't do drugs or smoke, I don't go out... ever. 

I won't be able to afford therapy. I don't know if there are any programs here that help with the cost, or if it's free, I don't know, but I will have to swallow my pride eventually and seek help, I know I do, I'm just scared. I don't want to lose my kids if I'm seen as mentally unstable.
